messages:
maria: Quick sync  immediate need: finalize customer-facing follow-up flow after the recent outage. Propose 3 outputs: public summary (24h), tech addendum (72h if impact threshold met), full RCA on request. Thoughts?

oscar: +1. Please include clear redaction rules and owner for full-RCA intake.

tara: Suggest impact thresholds: publish addendum if >1 hour outage OR >3% customer requests failed. Keep public summary one paragraph.

vikram: For recurring incidents we should auto-flag if >=2 similar within 30 days or >=3 in 90. When flagged, add a one-line recurrence note in the addendum with owner + ETA.

legal-bot: Reminder: avoid language implying liability. Use neutral, action-oriented phrasing. Example for addendum: "We observed similar instances; remediation is owned by <team> with target ETA."

maria: Action items: tara post public summary (owner: tara, due_ts:2445680100), oscar+tvikram draft addendum template (owner: oscar, due_ts:2445852000), vikram finalize recurrence signature with eng-ml (owner: vikram, due_ts:2445683600), maria add templates to repo + update runbook (owner: maria, due_ts:2445687200).

incident-bot: I can run nightly similarity checks and tag threads when thresholds hit. Will need eng-ml scoring endpoint and permission to label.

oscar: I'll coordinate with eng-ml tomorrow.

tara: I'll post the 24h public summary now and paste link.

incident-bot: Public summary posted to status page at 2445680000 (https://status.redwood.example/incident/2445678901)

maria: Great. I'll convert these to the comms SOP and create action tracker entries. Leave open for edits for 2h.

oscar: No objections.
